source.description: Unchanged raw Fengari step scheduling weights for 974 Lua fixtures. JS measurements are now recorded separately in jsSource. Lua weights, exclusive-worker classification and all deadlines remain unchanged.

jsSource.description: 408 unique successful native file summaries per platform; complete source file sets. Windows raw job logs, POSIX aggregate native summaries.

jsCorrections.description: Successful CI_FILE_TIMING 173508.69ms before pure projection caching. Retain this measured uncached cost as a conservative placement weight after caching; do not represent it as a new cached Linux measurement. Tests, shard counts, concurrency and deadlines remain unchanged.

Successful CI_FILE_TIMING 236252.55ms for the same expanded art input fixture. Correct placement only; tests, worker eligibility, shard counts and deadlines remain unchanged. The containing job passed tests, engineering and platform load, then reached its 30-minute limit during final receipt upload.

Successful CI_FILE_TIMING 132829.65ms after the complete ready-card art fixture was introduced. Correct placement only; all tests, assertions, shard counts, concurrency and deadlines remain unchanged. The containing job exceeded its 20-minute budget after all 890 tests passed.

luaShardSource.description: 1114 unique raw Lua fixture wall times from all eight original job logs, exactly equal to source inventory. Placement only; original lua safety weights and worker eligibility remain unchanged.

jsCalibration.policy: Only hosted CI_FILE_TIMING success===true observations raise each actual platform map; failed, partial and local runs never populate these observations. Unmeasured files retain the existing unknown fallback floor.

jsPlanning.model: Per-file maximum across the actual platform maps and explicit local lower bounds. This is a conservative placement estimate, not a Linux observation, cache, passing result, or timeout change.
